APIProxy.name: mock-signature-api
APIProxy.Description: Mock of the external signature API SF-Signature-Router's NI-Signature-*-Sign placeholders will eventually call. Always returns a fixed dummy success response per endpoint — no real HMAC or signature computation — enough to test the calling side's request/response wiring without a real backend. Set the X-Mock-Fail request header to "true" to get that endpoint's failure response instead.
